title: Captiva Watersports
specs: Renters must be at least 21 years of age with valid photo ID.
Info RENTERS MUST BE AT LEAST 21 YEARS OF AGE WITH VALID ID.

ANY PERSON BORN AFTER JANUARY 01, 1988 MUST HAVE A VALID FL BOATER'S SAFETY CARD or A NASBLA APPROVED SAFE BOATING LICENSE TO OPERATE A PWC.​ TEMPORARY FL BOATERS SAFETY CERTIFICATE TESTS (ALLOW APRX.
WAIVERS - Parasail must be completed BEFORE you arrive.
NO CHILDREN UNDER 4 - Sorry but no infants or children under 4 years of age are allowed on the boat, even as observers.
Flyers & Observers must be physically able to wade out and climb the ladder themselves to board.
Depending on wind conditions, the minimum weight for combined or single flyers is 200 pounds, and the maximum weight for combined or single flyers is 500 pounds.
UP TO 2 PEOPLE OR 450LBS PER SKI.
Tour not recommended for children under 8.
What to Know Operators must be 16 years and up with photo ID.

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: High parasailing flight offering 10–12 minute airborne rides with boat time of 30–60 minutes and options for flyers and observers. Highest & Longest Flight In Captiva · Picture Packages Available

services.name: Waverunner Rentals
services.desc: Exciting, family friendly, jetski rentals with half- and full-hour options in a large Gulf side ride area where wild life viewing is possible. 30-60 Minutes · Exciting Fun!

services.name: 19' Center Console/Yamaha 115HP
services.desc: Self-drive boat rentals to explore Captiva and nearby islands with options for half, three-quarter, or full day trips. 4-6 People (4 Adults Max)

services.name: Guided Waverunner Tour
services.desc: Fast-paced guided 1.5 hour wildlife tour with up to 2 people/450 LBS per ski. A Thrilling Wildlife Tour · 1.5 Hours

services.name: 24' Trimaran Pontoon / Yamaha 150hp
services.desc: Rent a captain-your-own boat to explore Captiva’s outer islands for shelling, snorkeling, fishing, wildlife watching, or a relaxed day on the water. 10 Passengers Maximum
